paras: NB: I am NOT saying use substances. However, many people attempt to do things for the first time such as self hypnosis, contact with their inner child, contact with their Higher Self etc when they are in a mind altered state.
If you do use them, be aware you don't want to force a revelation out of the state but instead use it to help you do things in your regular life.

If you have had an opening in the past, the key is to recognize that it is different to have an experience, access it in a particular state and access it in your day to day life. It is great that it has opened but if the child can't take it in, then meet the difficulty rather than escalating the intensity.

Use phrases such as; Help me to ground. Help me to only take that which I can take in. Help me to remember love. Help me to come back when the time is right. Help me to take one change into my regular life.
You should NOT use self hypnosis to; Keep you in that state forever Get memories to come up Make yourself afraid to do things Not sleep Override things that your body needs Not talk to people

If you are doing this in an altered state of consciousness and it is helping you not to love, not to ground, not to be honest, not to sleep, not to communicate, not to do regular life things, you need to STOP trying to go deeper and work on integrating what you have.

Self-hypnosis can be quite powerful when doing loveyhuasca, meditation, lucid dreaming, grieving, working with sexual energy, praying, not sleeping well, or doing a lot of the things people do around plant medicine work. Sometimes, people open up too fast for their adult self to make sense of what’s going on.

Sometimes it’s intensity, and that’s all it is. Sometimes it’s an inner child emerging. Sometimes it’s a Protector letting someone know they’re scared. Sometimes it’s shame, grief, anger, longing, or a host of other things coming up. Sometimes it’s the body experiencing too much going on inside. Sometimes it’s too much going on outside. Sometimes it’s lack of sleep, or a lack of ability to make sense of what’s going on. Sometimes it’s none of the above. Regardless, unless it’s a clear as day message, just because something came in a certain light, that doesn’t mean it’s true. Just because something felt bad, that doesn’t mean it’s true or helpful. Just because it felt like a “download”, that doesn’t mean it’s true.
